title: D621 PLAN law — pocket-scale rows the whole-table rows cannot see (D621-PLAN-1; thresholds committed here since D621-PLAN-3-RECORD-3)
principle: THE GATE TRUSTS ONLY THE TREE. Row ids, operators and thresholds live in this committed file (its sha256 is embedded in every verdict); row VALUES are re-measured from the export inside the gate, never read from a result file.
cut_notes: bed+20 / the model's nose height (bed+35.88) / cap top 814.68 − 1; bed top z = 770 in the model frame

registration_method.ruling: Maintainer FIX1 checkpoint ruling on PR #733 / 1f3f52724, 2026-09-09, item 3: register MODEL and OURS on their actual nose apex, symmetrically for every size. All cuts, thresholds, raster settings and 66 numeric rows remain unchanged.
registration_method.reason: The old MODEL-height registration sampled OURS below its apex. The historical four-mm nose made that depth error small; the smaller facet-derived radius exposes the offset even when ring geometry is byte-identical.
registration_method.apex: Use the median height of the exact innermost triangle-section endpoints on each straight rail, at the standing section planes; no radius assumption or target-derived height window. Section both sides by the same algorithm.
registration_method.secondary: Re-run all rows with the original MODEL-height registration and original coarse OURS apex search. Record each old value and verdict beside the deciding value; never use the secondary column to decide.
